about: Cordarone X (amiodarone) 200 mg is supplied six times from May to October 2026 with directions to take one tablet twice a day, by brand name only.

Amiodarone (Aratac) 200 mg is supplied four times from June to September 2026 with directions to take one tablet morning and night, near the end of a 15-month history that holds many other medicines, and the course covers more than one month within the three months before the record ends.
Each amiodarone 200 mg supply has directions that clearly say to take it once a day.
